We use the product rule, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(x\operatorname{sec}⁡x) \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(x)\cdot \operatorname{sec}⁡x+x\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(\operatorname{sec}⁡x) \\  & =(1)\cdot \operatorname{sec}⁡x+x\cdot (\operatorname{sec}⁡x\operatorname{tan}⁡x) \\  & =\operatorname{sec}⁡x(1+x\operatorname{tan}⁡x)\end{aligned}
$$
